evidence.title: GitHub - mahimailabs/voice-ai-skills: Vendor-neutral Agent Skills for people who build voice agents

name: Voice AI Skills
summary: Ten vendor-neutral Agent Skills that teach coding agents to build, review and debug real-time voice agents.
description: A collection of ten Agent Skills in the open Agent Skills format that give coding agents engineering judgment for voice agents: pipeline choice, turn-taking, interruptions, latency budget, prompting, function tools, telephony, evals, full-duplex and a 40-item production-readiness review. Versioned adapters connect the rules to LiveKit, Pipecat and Vapi, and an installer (Node.js 22.20+) or manual copy supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot.
contains: 10 agent skills for voice agent builders
versioned adapters for LiveKit, Pipecat and Vapi
installer CLI plus manual and Claude Code plugin installs
clinic booking example in LiveKit and Pipecat
docs on compatibility, vendor neutrality and testing
